summary: The 'GovTech Box' MVP targets municipal government technology needs in Ashtabula County. Research confirms 'New Ashtabula Initiative' is NOT a real-world entity—it is a placeholder/brand name for this project. Ashtabula County has an active Data Board/IT Services department overseeing technology procurement, with recent investments in Citizenserve (building software, $75K contract), electronic records systems, and court computer upgrades. The county currently uses CivicPlus (website), Granicus (communications), and Right Stuff Software (city operations). Multiple local IT providers serve the municipal market including InfinIT, VC3, and Summit IT Solutions.

leads.name: Ashtabula County Data Board / IT Services
leads.fit_rationale: Primary technology decision-maker for Ashtabula County. The Data Board oversees all IT purchases, software, and services for county offices. Recent procurements include $75K for Citizenserve building software and court computer upgrades. They manage IT infrastructure for 25+ county departments.

leads.name: InfinIT
leads.fit_rationale: Northeast Ohio IT provider with 35+ years specializing in municipal government. Offers managed IT, VoIP, SD-WAN, cybersecurity, and cloud solutions specifically for local governments. CJIS-compliant for police departments. Already serves municipalities in the region.

contact_info.services: Managed IT, Co-Managed IT, VoIP, Cybersecurity, Cloud Solutions

leads.name: Citizenserve
leads.fit_rationale: Ashtabula County Building Department just signed a $75,000 3-year contract (Feb 2025) for Citizenserve's cloud-based permitting and licensing software. Represents active procurement of municipal software in the county—potential partner or benchmark for GovTech Box.

leads.name: VC3 (Managed IT Services)
leads.fit_rationale: Specializes in local government IT services across Ohio. Provides managed IT, 24/7 support, and strategic planning for municipalities. Police, fire, water/sewer departments are key clients. Has presence in multiple Ohio cities including Defiance, Independence, and Blue Ash.

contact_info.specialization: Local Government, Police, Fire, Water/Sewer departments

leads.name: Granicus
leads.fit_rationale: Global leader in government customer engagement technology. Ashtabula County already uses Granicus (confirmed via technology stack analysis). Powers 30B+ digital interactions annually. Connects 500,000+ government professionals. Ideal integration partner or competitive benchmark.

contact_info.services: Digital communications, Public engagement, Meeting management

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout: Clean, centered, professional SaaS landing page structure. Effective use of whitespace.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_scheme: Professional navy/orange palette appropriate for B2G (business-to-government) services.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography: Clean serif/sans-serif pairing suitable for government-facing content.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.components: Well-styled input fields and buttons. Feature grid with icons is effective.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.white_label_potential: HIGH - The modular structure is perfectly suited for white-label deployment to different municipalities

whitelabel_potential.assessment: The GovTech Box MVP has excellent white-label potential. The architecture (Hero → Input → Features) is modular and easily adaptable. Sections can be swapped for different municipalities by changing: 1) Logo, 2) Primary accent color, 3) Regional references, 4) Footer text. The 'Official Municipality Toolkit' badge is a strong trust signal that transfers well across clients.
target_markets: Small to mid-size municipalities in Ohio
